simple_gagnant.selection_rule: positive EV within rank 1..4 by frozen V3 winning probability

ze5.selection_rule: top 5 runners by V3 win probability, irrespective of SG EV

limitations: Selection rules are a consistent paper research template, not proven profitable.
Top 5 by winning probability is not a trained finishing-top-five probability ranking.
Verify starters, odds and offer status before any real wager; quotes may change.
Record actual wagers and payouts only from user/operator evidence, never infer stakes or payouts.
Do not relax the prospective J-15 timing rule for the frozen SG EV experiment when earlier quotes are used to display a paper ticket.
No bets are submitted or placed automatically.
Keep archived V1 paper tickets and SG strategy comparisons immutable; the new four-threshold study uses version 2 on new eligible snapshots only.
